description: Returns a fix plan for the MACHINE_CHAIN_HEAVY finding: the files a crawler reads before the page and the 404s for absent agent files. Then measured reductions, with the chain size after each step and the step that clears the finding. Give domain: measured now, or with a licence key from its latest scan; a report id needs one. For why other findings fired use explain_finding.

domain.description: The site's domain. Measured now; with a licence key for it (x-crawlcheck-key), its latest scan on file is used instead

id.description: A report id; answers only with a licence key for that report's domain

name: fix_machine_chain
title: Fix a heavy machine-file chain
